response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and open-source experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, secure coding per IEC 62443, or cloud-native platform design as required; their recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only a brief, outdated C++ role from 2014–2015 that doesn't demonstrate current proficiency or relevance to the role’s core demands.
strengths: Strong full-stack and open-source project leadership with diverse tech exposure
Demonstrated experience in event-driven architectures and distributed systems
Active contributor to developer education and testing practices (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: No recent or substantial C++/STL experience in the last 9+ years
Lacks demonstrated exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or IoT protocols
No evidence of multi-threaded, low-latency C++ system design for on-prem/cloud automation platforms
